description: Dialectica is a fast-growing B2B information services firm founded in 2015 by George Tsarouchas and Frederick Corkett. Dialectica differentiates through its Athens-based operational model (which the firm positions as enabling competitive pricing relative to London/NYC-based peers), aggressive AI investment ($25M+ in tech, 50+ GenAI tools, Dialectica IQ knowledge graph), and its Origin deal-sourcing platform for private equity. Named to the FT 1000 (Europe's fastest-growing companies) for five consecutive years (2021-2025). The company is entirely bootstrapped and founder-owned.

overview: Dialectica is a B2B information services firm that has grown from a small Athens-based startup in 2015 to one of the fastest-growing expert networks globally. The company's model is built on running operations primarily from Athens rather than London or New York — a structure the firm positions as enabling competitive pricing while maintaining high service quality. This has fueled a 70% lifetime CAGR (60% for 2019-2024) and revenue crossing $100 million. Dialectica is now pushing aggressively into AI with its Dialectica IQ knowledge graph, 50+ GenAI tools, and Origin deal-sourcing platform, while expanding its compliance infrastructure by appointing Jason Howard (former General Counsel & CCO at Tegus, 13 years at SEC Enforcement) as Chief Legal & Regulatory Officer. The firm was upgraded to 'Global Leader' status by Inex One in 2024 and has publicly stated its ambition to become a top-three global information services firm by 2035.

history.narrative: Dialectica was co-founded in 2015 by George Tsarouchas (CEO) and Frederick Corkett. Tsarouchas previously worked for institutional investors (specific firm not publicly named; a Goldman Sachs attribution appears in one third-party source but is unverified). Corkett was a strategy consultant at AMR International. Note: some sources attribute an AlphaSights background to the founders, but this appears to be a misreading of Sacra's description of the business model Dialectica replicated, not an employment history. They started the company in Athens, Greece with a small sales office in London, deliberately choosing Athens for its talent pool and cost advantages during Greek capital controls. The firm grew rapidly, earning a place on the FT 1000 (Europe's fastest-growing companies) for five consecutive years (2021-2025) and crossing $100 million in revenue. The company is entirely bootstrapped and founder-owned, with no confirmed external funding.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: Dialectica's core offering: one-on-one and multi-party consultations with custom-sourced experts. The firm emphasizes high curation quality — a 1,000+ strong operations team based primarily in Athens manages expert sourcing, scheduling, and compliance. The firm positions its Athens-based operational model as enabling competitive pricing relative to London/NYC-headquartered peers.

servicesDetailed.name: B2B Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Scalable B2B surveys sourced through Dialectica's expert network and broader respondent panels. Surveys are designed for market sizing, competitive benchmarking, customer sentiment, and pricing studies. Can be paired with follow-up expert calls for deeper exploration.

servicesDetailed.name: Insights (Written Reports)
servicesDetailed.description: Consultant-style written deliverables delivered in 3-5 business days. Unlike competitors' searchable transcript libraries (Tegus, Third Bridge), Dialectica's Insights product is a bespoke research output — expert-sourced analysis and synthesis tailored to the client's specific question, enriched by AI-powered tools and the Dialectica IQ knowledge graph.

servicesDetailed.name: Origin (Deal Sourcing Platform)
servicesDetailed.description: A self-service deal-sourcing and market intelligence platform built for private equity, venture capital, and corporate strategy teams. Origin provides expert-vetted company snapshots, qualitative deal intelligence, and CRM integration. It targets workflow budgets currently allocated to deal-sourcing databases by offering the 'critical context that data tables miss.' Origin represents Dialectica's push beyond traditional expert calls into structured data products.

servicesDetailed.name: Dialectica IQ (Knowledge Graph & Content Platform)
servicesDetailed.description: Dialectica's proprietary knowledge graph structuring 80M+ company and market records plus metadata from 1M+ historical expert interactions. Unlike competitors' searchable transcript libraries (Tegus, Third Bridge), Dialectica IQ is architecturally different — a dynamic, continuously evolving graph that powers AI-driven insight extraction, expert recommendation, and automated research workflows. Includes 50+ GenAI tools layered on top.

aiPlatform.narrative: Dialectica has made AI a central part of its identity and growth strategy. The firm positions itself as 'redefining how knowledge is discovered, indexed, and synthesized' through its Dialectica IQ knowledge graph — a dynamic, continuously evolving system that structures 80M+ company and market records and metadata from 1M+ historical expert interactions. The firm operates with 50+ advanced GenAI tools, proprietary AI agents, and a team of 100+ software engineers, data scientists, and product specialists ($25M+ invested in technology over the past 3 years). Datasets are enriched by a 1,000+ operations team, combining human intelligence with AI at scale. Notably, Dialectica does NOT offer a traditional searchable transcript library like Tegus or Third Bridge — its approach is knowledge-graph-first.

complianceExtended.narrative: Dialectica has significantly invested in compliance infrastructure as it scales into larger institutional accounts. In January 2025, Dialectica appointed Jason Howard as Chief Legal & Regulatory Officer. Howard previously served as General Counsel & Chief Compliance Officer at Tegus (~5 years) and spent 13 years at the SEC Division of Enforcement. The firm uses technology-assisted vetting combined with human compliance review, and its proprietary AI tools include automated compliance monitoring capabilities. As a newer entrant (founded 2015), Dialectica's compliance infrastructure is less battle-tested than incumbents like GLG or Guidepoint, but the Howard appointment signals the firm is actively closing this gap.
